guard.message: Framing is within the range the model was trained on (retina fills 69.9%; training range 61.4%-81.7%).

disclaimer: Research prototype. NOT a medical device, and not for clinical use.
Below the screening reference in-domain: referable sensitivity 0.7360 at 95% specificity, against a 0.80 reference that is itself provisional.
Demonstrated dependence on image framing, stronger on external data than on the training distribution. Present in two of three training runs.
The decision thresholds are NOT transferable. They were fitted on EyePACS; any use on a new population requires local recalibration.
_note: SYNTHETIC, hand-built. No local image produces this state, and hunting for one is the wrong tool: the frontend needs to RENDER the state, not discover it. The score sits midway between the referral threshold (0.9488) and the grade-1->2 cut point (1.6216), which is exactly the band where grade and referral disagree. Every other field is a real response.
